name: Paper & Ink — cinematic documentary
description: Locked palette and material language for backgrounds, cards, scraps and overlays. Paper is warm, ink is soft black, accents are oxblood/ochre/sage.
prompt_prefix: vintage documentary paper asset, warm cream paper, muted oxblood and ochre, soft print grain, flat scan, no text, no letters
negative: text, letters, words, typography, watermark, signature, logo, caption, people, faces, hands, modern objects, glossy, neon, 3d render, photorealistic, busy background

aged_paper.description: Warm aged paper for full-frame backgrounds and text cards.

parchment.description: Warmer, older parchment with heavier mottling.

kraft_paper.description: Brown kraft paper for craft/collage scenes.

newsprint.description: Greyish newsprint with a subtle halftone screen.

grid_paper.description: Cream graph paper for data, maps and technical explanations.

lined_paper.description: Cream ruled paper for notes and letters.

torn_paper.description: Torn paper card with transparent edges and a soft shadow.

paper_scrap.description: Small irregular paper scrap for collage.

postcard.description: Aged postcard with border, stamp box and postmark rings.

poster.description: Textless vintage poster background with geometric blocks.

photo_frame.description: White photo frame with transparent centre.

sticker.description: Die-cut paper sticker with a white border.

label_tag.description: Paper label tag with a punched hole.
